decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The details of materials to be used in the construction of external surfaces of the approved extension, as submitted by Limbrick Architecture and Design received 18 May 2007 and detailed below; pursuant to condition no.2 of planning permission 00946/B/P24, dated 19 April 2007, are satisfactory and approval is recommended without the addition of further conditions.

Roofs

Tennis Hall - Corrugated metal roof cladding (painted abrasion resistant aluminium), light grey colour (Euro Clad profile ES400, colour 10A05, 9mm gauge).

Club building - Thermoplastic membrane, grey in colour (Alkor Draka Single Membrane: AlkorPlan F: Grey)

	Walls

Tennis Hall - Metal cladding, white in colour (Corus Microrib Metal Composite Cladding, Corus Colorcoat HPS2000: Colour  - White 00E55).

Club building -. Brickwork is face brickwork speckled orange/ gold colour (Ibstock Barley Golden Mutli). Timber cladding horizontal western red cedar cladding (Kingspan Timber Ventilated Rainscreen System). Rendered panels, off white in colour (K Render Scraped Smooth Textured Finish). 

Glazing

The glazing is a curtain wall system with powder coated aluminium framing, grey in colour (Kawneer 1202 Curtain walling system, colour: RAL 9007 Metallic silver).
description: Following approval for the redevelopment and erection of a health and racquets club following a fire and the provision of a temporary plastic dome structure over three courts during winter season, details submitted pursuant to Condition 2 (Materials) of permission 00946/B/P24 dated 19/04/07.
